title: Implement atomic Photo admission and recovery

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Python tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m pytest tests/test_foundation.py tests/unit

evidence_required: FT-001-AC-002 RED: before changing production behavior, an isolated sequential/concurrent same-scope duplicate probe must fail to obtain exactly one accepted winner plus duplicate losers with one Photo, one serving-pending row and one retained original; retain the failing assertion and disposable-state conditions under .tasks/TASK-003-T2-FT-001-W1/.

FT-001-AC-002 GREEN: the claim-equivalent isolated probe must record request outcomes, configured scope/checksum, Photo/pending/object counts, loser-candidate deletion, pass/fail comparison and owned cleanup artifact.

FT-001-AC-003 RED: an isolated success/exception-before-commit probe must show that the absent implementation cannot establish the required all-or-none Photo plus serving-pending publication; retain the claim-scoped failure.
FT-001-AC-003 GREEN: success and injected rollback must record the transaction boundary, exactly one complete pair or zero database admission, decisive row counts, comparison and artifact.

FT-001-AC-005 RED: an isolated post-object/pre-commit interruption and re-upload fixture must fail before implementation to demonstrate the accepted no-database-admission/recovery behavior; the probe uses only a disposable bucket prefix and database state.

FT-001-AC-005 GREEN: the same fixture must record the inaccessible orphan condition, zero Photo/pending rows, successful ordinary re-upload, final object/database counts, safe rerun and owned cleanup.

Migration evidence records the pre-task linear head, the feature revision's direct down_revision, upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade results, schema constraints and preservation of the Foundation migration without treating a later mutable head as an FT-001 requirement.
Independent /verify evidence includes a fresh verifier-owned outcome probe and VERDICT: PASS for every task-scoped AC/REQ/spec claim before closure.
purpose: Create the owner-safe data and application boundary that independently admits one valid unique JPEG and recovers according to the accepted PostgreSQL/MinIO contract.
success_outcome: From isolated configured state, one valid unique candidate becomes one inventory-owned Photo and one processing-owned serving-revision pending row in a single PostgreSQL commit; rejects and sequential/concurrent duplicates create no extra state, and a post-object/pre-commit interruption leaves no database admission while ordinary re-upload succeeds.
anti_goals: Do not expose an HTTP/UI upload route, implement staff credentials/sessions or claim the authenticated public-boundary outcome owned by TASK-004.
Do not implement background claiming, inference, retries or ready/no_faces/failed publication from FT-002.
Do not implement Photo listing, visibility, soft delete/restore, statistics or hard purge from FT-012.
Do not add Batch, manifest, confirmation, resumable upload, outbox, broker, distributed transaction, orphan lifecycle or generic settings/job machinery.

forbidden_scope: FT-002 processing behavior beyond immutable serving-revision identity and initial pending creation
Staff HTTP authentication/session/UI behavior assigned to TASK-004
Production deployment, production credentials, operator/default persistent-volume mutation or public object-store access
stop_conditions: The Photo, serving target, pending-state, uniqueness, transaction or accepted orphan-recovery contract would need to change.
Implementation requires direct foreign repository writes, business orchestration in an HTTP handler/generic utility/composition root, or a new capability owner.
The linear Alembic stream or one shared Base/MetaData cannot be preserved.
The RED/GREEN or integration probe cannot use isolated disposable PostgreSQL/MinIO state with safe rerun and owned cleanup.

constraints: Primary owner and orchestration root: inventory at src/face_moment/inventory/; serving_control supplies immutable IngestTarget and processing owns only the initial pending command used here.

Create only the minimum owner-backed active Spa and immutable eligible pipeline-revision records defined by the Photo Admission spec; no production seed, operator settings UI, inference behavior or revision-switch lifecycle is authorized.
Use direct typed Python application boundaries under the inventory owner; one physical schema and one transaction do not permit direct foreign repository writes or shared business ownership.
Write candidate bytes under a unique opaque key in the configured private MinIO bucket, calculate SHA-256 over the exact bytes, and keep the accepted key without move/copy.

Treat uploader_id as an application-supplied immutable UUID in this non-public core task; isolated tests may use a synthetic UUID, and TASK-004 supplies the authenticated principal without requiring a cross-capability database foreign key.
Use deployment-configured positive compressed-byte, decoded-side and decoded-pixel limits with explicit deterministic test values.
Author the migration from the current linear Alembic head and verify its own direct ancestry, upgrade/downgrade, schema transition and data behavior.
Exact owner-local Python filenames and the migration revision filename remain implementation discretion; capability roots, public boundaries and persistence identities do not.
invariants: PostgreSQL uniqueness on (spa_id, visit_date, checksum_sha256) is the only concurrent winner arbiter.
A committed accepted result publishes one Photo, server accepted_at and one serving-revision pending row together; rollback publishes none.
Rejected and duplicate candidates never enter Photo, pipeline, searchable, teaser or N populations and delete only their request-owned object when handled.
A crash after private object upload but before commit may leave one inaccessible orphan; it creates no database admission and ordinary re-upload remains sufficient recovery.
The photographer-selected visit_date remains authoritative even when reliable EXIF differs; effective captured_at follows the canonical fallback order.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-002: isolated sequential and concurrent duplicate probes compare outcomes plus Photo, serving-pending and MinIO object counts before/after, including loser cleanup.
FT-001-AC-003: isolated success and injected pre-commit rollback prove the complete Photo+pending pair or zero database admission.
FT-001-AC-005: isolated post-object/pre-commit interruption proves no exposed/database admission, successful ordinary re-upload, safe rerun and owned cleanup.

REQ-ARCH-001: static/integration evidence locates inventory as the primary owner, crosses only typed serving_control/processing boundaries and finds no handler, generic-util or composition-root business orchestration.
